answer NOTES. 1. I am Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker of the order under Never-Writes-Twice. I entered Fort Chalkmoth unseen via the yard trapdoor into the cellar guardroom. Sap jars tied with the knot of Jal-Veesa tree-minder are stacked in the quartermaster store, in a fort with no Hist of its own. The gaoler Tsleel-Vaku refused me and said Never-Writes-Twice keeps the inner cellar door key; I failed to persuade or charm him and the door cannot be picked. Something moans behind it. 2. Go back to the order hunt: go to Bell Station, an islet east of Lilmoth by boat, where the divers know which drowned tower the marker stone shows; the Eye of Argonia is at the Root. 3. Options: go to Bell Station; or later find the cellar key from Never-Writes-Twice, or the wall captain Sakeeus-Wan offers keep access for killing three Sarpa raiders, which I did not do. 4. Unknown: who is in the cellar, why the order feeds them sap, what the Root and Eye really are, and who the Collector is. I carry the rapier, about 1050 gold, 2 lockpicks, 3 paralysis poisons, the keystone, eye-setting, bronze disc, map, unbound note.
